zh: 数组 a 很短（至多 100 个）而且从不改变；固定 a 中的一个下标后，满足条件的 b 下标恰好是值等于 target 减去该数的那些位置，所以只需要知道 b 中每个值出现了多少次。
用哈希表维护 b 的值频次。更新时先把旧值的次数减一，再把新值的次数加一；查询时枚举 a 的每个数，累加 b 中补数的出现次数。
读入 a 和 b 并统计 b 的频次；对每个操作：若是更新，把 b[i] 旧值的频次减 1，令 b[i] 加上 x，再把新值频次加 1；若是查询，对 a 中每个数 v 累加频次表中 target−v 的次数并输出一行；没有查询时输出一个空行。
en: Array a is tiny (at most 100 elements) and never changes. For a fixed index of a, the valid indices of b are exactly those whose value equals target minus that number, so you only need how many times each value occurs in b.

Keep a hash map of value frequencies for b. On an update, decrease the count of the old value and increase the count of the new value. On a query, go over every number in a and add the frequency of its complement in b.

Read a and b and build the frequency map of b. For an update, decrease the count of the old b[i], add x to b[i], and increase the count of the new value. For a query, add up the count of target - v over every v in a and print it on its own line. If there are no queries, print an empty line.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Maintain the frequencies of b. An update first decreases the old value's frequency and then increases the new value's; a query enumerates every number in a and adds up how many times target minus that number appears in b.

## Correctness

For a fixed index of a, all complement indices in b are exactly the valid partners. Different indices of a give different pairs, so summing the frequencies is exact; before and after each update the frequencies stay consistent with the array.

## Complexity

Time O(nb+q·na), space O(nb+q+na), where storing the queries belongs to input parsing.
